evidence.description: Probe inversion: symlinked evidence file -> exit 2, offender named, no GAPS.md written.
Symlinked evidence subdirectory refused the same way.

The original pre-fix probe against the fixed tree: exit 2, GAPS.md MISSING (was exit 0, gap closed, pre-fix).

falsification_tests: Run gaps with a symlinked evidence file pointing outside the project root and show a gap closing anyway, or show an all-real evidence tree being refused.

claims.text: The token-economy shell wrapper runs the command with cwd pinned to the project root, under --timeout (default 600 s, timeout = exit 2 recorded with timed_out: true), and redacts secret-looking argv values from the telemetry record; the trust model (telemetry wrapper, not a sandbox) is stated in docs/token-economy.md.

Telemetry for argv token=SUPERSECRETARG123 contains token=<redacted> and never the value.
A 10 s sleeper under --timeout 1 is killed; wrapper returns 2; record has timed_out true and exit_code null.
Original probe: cwd is now the project root and telemetry shows token=<redacted>; the outside cat still prints because shell is a telemetry wrapper, not a sandbox - now stated in docs.

falsification_tests: Run shell from another cwd and show the command executing there, find a verbatim secret in shell-calls.jsonl, or show a runaway command surviving --timeout.

claims.text: Token-router discovery is confined to the project root and its parent (an out-of-domain TOKEN_ROUTER_HOME is ignored and routing falls back deterministically); router ranges are strictly typed (JSON booleans rejected); the route record names the router path and SHA-256 whenever the token-router backend runs.

evidence.description: _find_token_router returns None for a TOKEN_ROUTER_HOME in an unrelated tree; live probe5_after.py confirms the fake router never executes and backend is deterministic.
Router output [[true,3],[2,4],['5',9]] parses to exactly [(2,4)].
Route record's router.path and router.sha256 match the executed router file.

Out-of-domain TOKEN_ROUTER_HOME: backend deterministic, router executed-marker absent, no router key in the record (in-domain parent-tree router in probe2 still runs but its [[true,3]] is now rejected).

falsification_tests: Execute a router from an out-of-domain TOKEN_ROUTER_HOME, get [[true,3]] accepted as a range, or produce a token-router record without router identity.
